dialogue: This strategy is mainly used to handle scenarios where API authentication fails (e.g., token expiration). speaker: Mingzhi Li

Before rejection, a `SEC_AUDIT_FLAG` must be added to the event.

speaker: Haitao Cao
dialogue: @Wei Ya I encountered this problem before when I was working on a CMS dashboard. Did you directly update the entire tree data using `setState` in the `onClick` event? You can try updating only the operated node and its associated parent and child nodes, instead of the entire `dataSource`. Or, if the component supports it, using `loadData` to asynchronously load child nodes can also greatly improve performance.
